name: claude-session-restore
description: Snapshot active Claude Code sessions for a workspace and restore them in separate terminals when the workspace reopens.

commands.title: Claude Sessions: Snapshot Active Sessions Now
Claude Sessions: Clear This Workspace Snapshot

claudeSessionRestore.enabled.description: Enable automatic session snapshots and restore.

claudeSessionRestore.autoRestore.description: Automatically open terminals and resume snapshotted sessions when the workspace opens.

claudeSessionRestore.allowUntrustedWorks.description: Allow automatic restore in untrusted workspaces. Not recommended.

claudeSessionRestore.snapshotIntervalSec.description: How often to snapshot active sessions while the window is open. Set to 0 to disable the timer (deactivate snapshot still runs).

claudeSessionRestore.restoreDelayMs.description: Delay after extension activation before restoring terminals. 0 starts sessions immediately.

claudeSessionRestore.staggerMs.description: Delay between creating restored terminals. 0 creates them in parallel.

claudeSessionRestore.launchMode.description: shell: create a terminal and send the claude command. direct: launch the native claude.exe as the terminal process, skipping PowerShell/cmd startup. Use direct for experiments.

claudeSessionRestore.diagnostics.description: Write phase timings to restore-diagnostics.jsonl in the extension workspace storage.

claudeSessionRestore.maxSessions.description: Maximum number of sessions to snapshot/restore per workspace.

claudeSessionRestore.revealTerminals.description: Reveal the first restored terminal. Other terminals are created in the background.

claudeSessionRestore.claudeCommand.description: Command used in restored terminals. Use 'claude' when it is on PATH, or an absolute path to claude.exe.

claudeSessionRestore.extraArgs.description: Extra arguments appended to the resume command, e.g. ["--dangerously-skip-permissions"]. These are trusted local settings.

claudeSessionRestore.clearSnapshotWhenNo.description: When a successful query finds no active sessions, clear the saved snapshot instead of keeping it.
